original_question: For a strictly separating intermediate cone C_i, interpret the dual cone C_i^∨ in homogeneous truncated moment terms. Concretely, determine what kind of homogeneous truncated moment sequences or representing measures correspond to membership in C_i^∨, in analogy with the identification of P_{n+1,2d}^∨ as the cone of homogeneous truncated moment sequences that admit representing measures supported on the unit sphere S^n.
target_in_paper: Section 3.2, Open Problem 3: interpret the dual cone C_i^∨ for a strictly separating intermediate cone C_i in the setting of the homogeneous truncated moment problem, using the cone filtration Σ_{n+1,2d}=C_0⊆⋯⊆C_{k(n,d)-n}=𝒫_{n+1,2d} and the strictness pattern in (6). ([semsao.imj-prg.fr](https://semsao.imj-prg.fr/DDG-2022-2024.pdf))
correct_elements: Your draft is aimed at the right place in the paper: it matches Section 3.2’s Open Problem 3, not a broader neighboring question. In particular, it correctly focuses on a strictly separating intermediate cone C_i, on the dual cone C_i^∨, and on the analogy with the paper’s identification of 𝒫_{n+1,2d}^∨ as the cone of homogeneous truncated moment sequences admitting representing measures supported on the unit sphere S^n. ([semsao.imj-prg.fr](https://semsao.imj-prg.fr/DDG-2022-2024.pdf))
missing_details: The ambient objects should be stated explicitly: n,d∈ℕ, the ground field is ℝ, and C_i is a cone inside the real vector space ℱ_{n+1,2d} of homogeneous forms in n+1 variables of even degree 2d. ([semsao.imj-prg.fr](https://semsao.imj-prg.fr/DDG-2022-2024.pdf))

The paper asks this only for a strictly separating intermediate cone, meaning a non-Hilbert case and an index i with Σ_{n+1,2d}⊊C_i⊊𝒫_{n+1,2d}; the relevant filtration and strictness pattern are those of (5) and (6). ([semsao.imj-prg.fr](https://semsao.imj-prg.fr/DDG-2022-2024.pdf))

To be stand-alone, the dual cone should be defined precisely as the cone of linear functionals nonnegative on C_i; Section 3 introduces C_i^∨ in this sense before Section 3.2 specializes to linear functionals on ℱ_{n+1,2d}. ([semsao.imj-prg.fr](https://semsao.imj-prg.fr/DDG-2022-2024.pdf))

The homogeneous truncated moment data need to be written out: a sequence y=(y_α) indexed by I_{n+1,2d}={α∈ℕ_0^{n+1}:|α|=2d}, together with its Riesz functional ℒ_y on degree-2d homogeneous forms. ([semsao.imj-prg.fr](https://semsao.imj-prg.fr/DDG-2022-2024.pdf))

The representing measures in the relevant interpretation are nonnegative Borel measures supported on the unit sphere S^n⊂ℝ^{n+1}, and the question should ask which such y or μ correspond exactly to ℒ_y∈C_i^∨. ([semsao.imj-prg.fr](https://semsao.imj-prg.fr/DDG-2022-2024.pdf))

The draft does not say that the intended characterization should locate C_i^∨ inside the dual filtration Σ_{n+1,2d}^∨⊇⋯⊇𝒫_{n+1,2d}^∨; that is part of the immediate setup in Section 3.2. ([semsao.imj-prg.fr](https://semsao.imj-prg.fr/DDG-2022-2024.pdf))

A nearby but different question in the paper is Open Problem 4, which asks for a relation to the 𝒜_i-truncated moment problem with 𝒜_i={α_s+α_t:0≤s,t≤n+i}; your draft should not be broadened into that separate sparse reformulation unless one explicitly wants that neighboring problem instead. ([semsao.imj-prg.fr](https://semsao.imj-prg.fr/DDG-2022-2024.pdf))
refined_question: Let n,d∈ℕ be in a non-Hilbert case, let k(n,d)=dim(ℱ_{n+1,d})−1, and let Σ_{n+1,2d}=C_0⊆⋯⊆C_{k(n,d)-n}=𝒫_{n+1,2d} be the specific cone filtration from the paper. Fix an index i such that Σ_{n+1,2d}⊊C_i⊊𝒫_{n+1,2d}, and consider the dual cone C_i^∨⊂ℱ_{n+1,2d}^*. For a homogeneous truncated moment sequence y=(y_α)_{α∈I_{n+1,2d}}, where I_{n+1,2d}={α∈ℕ_0^{n+1}:|α|=2d}, let ℒ_y(∑_{|α|=2d} f_αX^α)=∑_{|α|=2d} f_αy_α. Since 𝒫_{n+1,2d}^∨ is identified in the paper with the cone of those y admitting a nonnegative Borel representing measure μ supported on the unit sphere S^n⊂ℝ^{n+1}, characterize the intermediate dual cone C_i^∨ in the same homogeneous truncated moment language: namely, determine exactly which homogeneous truncated moment sequences y, or equivalently which sphere-supported representing measures μ, satisfy ℒ_y∈C_i^∨. ([semsao.imj-prg.fr](https://semsao.imj-prg.fr/DDG-2022-2024.pdf))
justification: The paper first sets up the cones C_i in Section 1 and records when they are strictly separating via (6). It then defines the dual cone C_i^∨ at the start of Section 3. In Section 3.2, it recalls the homogeneous truncated moment interpretation of 𝒫_{n+1,2d}^∨ and immediately states Open Problem 3: “Interpret C_i^∨ in the setting of the homogeneous truncated moment problem.” Your draft closely paraphrases that exact passage and sharpens it by unpacking what such an interpretation would have to mean—namely, a characterization of the homogeneous truncated moment sequences or representing measures corresponding to membership in C_i^∨. This is closer to Open Problem 3 than to Open Problem 2 (explicit description of C_i^∨) or Open Problem 4 (the distinct 𝒜_i-truncated moment problem). ([semsao.imj-prg.fr](https://semsao.imj-prg.fr/DDG-2022-2024.pdf))
